brief: Distinguish an economy-wide inflation measure from one household’s changing expenses.

title.es-MX: Un índice no es tu recibo
title.pt-BR: Um índice não é seu recibo

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "An index is not your receipt"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Un índice no es tu recibo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Um índice não é seu recibo"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Distinguish an economy-wide inflation measure from one household’s changing expenses.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A broad price index and your household’s spending can change differently.
instruction.misconception: Treating a broad consumer-price measure as the exact price change of every household, product or spending total.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: A price index combines many prices with defined weights. Your household may buy a different mix, so its experience differs.
An aggregate measure does not describe every household’s exact purchases.
Different spending shares can produce different experienced price changes.
One category can rise faster than the weighted overall measure.
Changing household needs can change spending independently of prices.
Different reporting periods answer different questions.
Check the measure’s scope and compare your own spending records.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
